props.title: New Article: Prediction Markets Know What the Crowd Will Do. They Don't Know Why.

props.text: Prediction markets hit $24 billion in monthly volume by April 2026, and AI forecasting benchmarks show frontier models now match market accuracy on binary outcomes. But both compress collective intelligence into a single number, discarding the mechanism that produced it. MiroShark takes the opposite approach — simulating synthetic crowds across platforms to decompose the probability into the conversation, the belief shifts, and the narrative dynamics that markets can't show.
